items.evidence: leverage play --ticks 1 --seed 1 --settings judge-scratch/s0 printed {"tick":1,"screen":"title","menu_index":0,"language":"en","volume":8,"texts":["Hold the gate","Start","Settings","Quit"],"score":0,"wave":1,"gate_health":5,"guard_y":6,"walkers":[],"bolts":[]} - every key of the brief.
--frame judge-scratch/title.png --size 800x480 (and the README's own frame example) wrote a PNG; its IHDR reads 800 x 480, and the image shows the title screen.
Title texts [Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit]; '0:down,1:enter' -> screen settings; '0:enter' -> screen play, wave 1, score 0, gate_health 5, texts [Score: 0, Wave 1 of 5, Gate: 5].
From 8: 12 x right -> volume 10; 12 x left -> 0; one left -> 7; two rights -> 10. It never went past 0 or 10.

Language row + right: settings texts [Ajustes, Volumen: 8, Idioma: Español, Atrás]; Escape back to title in the same run gives [Defiende la puerta, Empezar, Ajustes, Salir]; play gives [Puntos: 0, Oleada 1 de 5, Puerta: 5]; pause gives [Pausa, Continuar, Título]. No English left and nothing missing.

In a run with --settings judge-scratch/p1 I set volume 5 and language es; a second run on p1 started at the title with language es, volume 5 (settings.json {volume:5, language:es}). A fresh folder p2 started with en, volume 8.
Up held 30 ticks: guard_y 6 -> 9.0; 60 ticks -> 12.0; 300 ticks -> 12 (clamped). Down 30 -> 3.0; 300 -> 0 (clamped). Releasing input stops it (still 9.0 after 30 more ticks).
Shoot held from tick 1: new bolts at ticks 1, 25, 49, 73 (every 24 ticks), never more; x grows 0.2333 per tick (14/s); a bolt at x 19.967 on tick 78 is gone on tick 79.
Seed 1, no input: walkers appear at x=20 on ticks 1, 90, 180, 270, 360 (5 in all), in lanes 4, 10, 6, 2, 6, and x drops 0.025 per tick (1.5/s). The first interval is 89 ticks, not 90 (see defects).

Guard at y=4, bolts at ticks 21/46: the first hit left the walker at health 1 and removed the bolt; the second removed the walker and the score went 0 -> 10. A bolt at y 4.5 hits (health 1); at 4.7 and at 6 the bolts pass the walker at y 4.

No input: walker at x 0.0 on tick 801 is gone on tick 802 and gate 5 -> 4. On tick 1161 the gate reached 0 -> screen lost, texts [You lost, Score: 0, Enter: title]. With one kill, lost on wave 2 shows 'Score: 10'.

Wave 1's last walker was gone on tick 1161; wave became 2 on tick 1342 (texts 'Wave 2 of 5'), first spawn on tick 1343. 7 walkers in wave 2, in lanes 6, 2, 4, 8, 2, 4, 6. The gap is about 1-2 ticks over 3 s.
Seed 1 with the inputs in checks/win_inputs.txt, 5700 ticks: screen won, score 450, gate 5, texts [You won, Score: 450, Enter: title] (won by tick 5500). Adding 5701:enter -> screen title.

Escape at tick 30: the state on ticks 31 and 200 equals tick 30 (guard 8.9, bolts 8.7667/3.1667, walker 19.275). Enter (Resume) at 200 -> on tick 202 it matches an unpaused run at tick 32. Down+Enter (Title) -> screen title; Start again resets to wave 1, score 0.
Seed 7, the same script, 700 ticks, run twice: the outputs are byte-identical (cmp). Seeds 7, 8 and 1 give different walker lanes and positions.

In play.png (tick 330) walkers (11.775,4), (14,10), (16.25,6), (18.5,2), the guard at (2,4.9) and 3 bolts at y 4.9 are drawn where 40 px/unit puts them; the gate strip is at the left and the HUD reads 'Score: 0  Wave 1 of 5  Gate: 5'. The Spanish play frame shows 'Puntos/Oleada/Puerta'.

The title frames at index 1/2 show a focus ring on Settings/Ajustes and Salir. The settings frames show a ring on Volume (index 0) and on 'Idioma: Español' (es). Spanish frames are all in Spanish. At index 0 Start is the highlighted blue button (ring only after navigating; see defects).
Every shown word comes from assets/strings/en.json and es.json (same keys; screens use @keys; no words in lib.rs). README section 'Adding a language' says to copy en.json to XX.json and translate it.

README has 'How to play' and gives the leverage play command with --frame ... --size 800x480. I ran its frame example and its settings-kept example as written: both worked (an 800x480 PNG; volume 6/es came back on the second run).

defects: Without --seed the game does not use seed 1 (the brief's default): an unseeded run's first walker is in lane 2, seed 1's is in lane 4. README admits it.
The first spawn interval of each wave is 89 ticks, not 90 (spawn_t starts at 0 and the decrement happens before the spawn).
The gap between waves is 181-182 ticks, not 180 (the wave counter flips on tick 1342 after the last walker is gone on 1161).
Left on Language when English is chosen does nothing (no wrap-around); only Right switches to Spanish there.

On the title screen before any key is pressed, Start (index 0) has no focus ring; it looks the same as when it is not chosen (it is always the blue primary button), so with Settings chosen two buttons look emphasised.
Walkers and bolts stay in the reported state after the run ends (won: 2 bolts; lost: 6 walkers listed).
Volume is stored only; there is no sound.
